title: EmbedPolicyResponse
description: What `ai` returns from `POST /embed-policy` — the policy document split into chunks, each with its embedding vector. `api` persists these as `policy_chunk` rows.

model.description: Identifier of the embedding model that produced every vector in this response, so a later dimension or model change is traceable per chunk.

embedding_dimensions.description: Length of every `embedding` array in `chunks`. Never assumed by `api` — always read from here.

chunk_index.description: 0-based position of this chunk within the document, so retrieval results can be traced back to their place in the source text.
